correctness.rationale: For R_{m,n}=K_m square K_n with m,n>=2, selected squares correspond to edges of K_{m,n}. A pair of non-row/non-column squares is visible if at least one other rectangle corner is unselected, so mutual visibility is exactly C4-freeness and inclusion maximality is C4 saturation. Saturation forces spanning connectivity; equality size m+n-1 forces a tree. In a tree adding a missing opposite-part edge creates C4 exactly at tree distance three; hence all opposite distances <=3 iff diameter<=4, iff a universal vertex adjacent to the entire opposite part. Counting row-centered and column-centered trees yields m*n^(m-1)+n*m^(n-1)-m*n, the overlap being double-stars. Unlabeled row-centered degree profiles are integer partitions of m-1 into <=n parts and analogous column profiles, with double-star counted twice and factor exchange only if m=n. Fresh direct shortest-path subset enumeration matched labeled counts on (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4). This is a finite check; the structural tree classification proves every board.
